title: A measure in a function body is evaluated in the filter context of the call

source.quote: Use a UDF in a measure to apply reusable logic with full filter context.
source.supports: a function is evaluated in the filter context where it is called

source.quote: Starting from the September 2025 version, it is possible to define functions, which are parametrized expressions that can be reused throughout the entire semantic model.
source.supports: a function is an expression, evaluated where it is used

derivation: The call is inside CALCULATE with Color = Blue, so the measure in the body sees that filter: rows 4, 6 = 50 + 30 = 80.
alternative: Neither page states outright in which filter context the body of a function is evaluated. If the body ignored the filter of the call, the result would be the total 540.
